domain_label: Higgsfield Prompting & Model Ops — The Connected MCP Model Catalog as Ground Truth
purpose: A method for the model-ops decisions an expert makes against the live Higgsfield MCP surface: reading the enumerated catalog (30 image / 28 video / 5 audio models, has_more:false, 2026-07-03) as the only authority on what is callable, mapping media roles per model (the 11 both-frames video models vs the six start-frame-only ones), honoring the speech-only generate_audio constraint, choosing between trained Souls and instant Reference Elements for identity, and running a shot-type decision tree (solo hero portrait, duo shot, car/product, landscape/establishing, motion-heavy, dialogue) whose every model name and parameter comes from the enumeration file, never from memory.
assumptions: no generation credits were spent during enumeration; every platform-capability claim is a read of the live MCP surface on 2026-07-03 (models_explore list/get, presets_show, get_workflow_instructions, show_characters, show_reference_elements, balance, and the loaded generate_image/generate_video/generate_audio/motion_control schemas), and every score in this KB is a heuristic prior
the account state at enumeration was 1,010 credits on the plus plan; per-generation credit cost is UNKNOWN until the run phase probes it with get_cost:true

prompt-craft guidance (Veo five-part formula, FLUX word order, Kling formula, MiniMax bracket commands, Sora one-move-one-action, plastic-skin fixes) comes from the prompting research file's sourced claims; several official pages were 403-blocked and carried only via search excerpts, one notch below fully-fetched fact

the MCP catalog is treated as authoritative over higgsfield.ai marketing pages: 'Sora' and 'Cinema Studio 3.5' appear on marketing pages but not in this account's catalog (has_more:false on all three lists)
whether the plus plan hides models visible on ultra is UNKNOWN; the catalog is ground truth for this account only
exclusions: story, script, persona-biography and content-strategy decisions — this KB covers which model/parameters to call and how to word the call, not what the movie says
engagement statistics, platform-policy claims, legal cases and psychology findings — none were carried by the grounding files and none are invented here
any guidance for evoking a specific real person while hiding the face — the likeness closed-lane stays closed
credit-price tables per model — costs are UNKNOWN on the read surface and only obtainable via the get_cost:true probe at run time
the website/game/shorts/clipper tool families beyond noting they exist on the server; this KB covers the generate_image/generate_video/generate_audio/motion_control movie path

glossary.definition: The declared slot a media input fills on a model's medias[] schema — image, start_image, end_image, image_references, video_references, audio_references, input_video. What a model can be conditioned on is read from its roles, not guessed [FACT - live MCP surface 2026-07-03].

A video model whose medias[].roles include BOTH start_image and end_image, enabling first/last-frame interpolation. Exactly 11 exist in this catalog: cinematic_studio_3_0, cinematic_studio_video_v2, cinematic_studio_video, seedance_2_0, seedance_2_0_mini, seedance1_5, kling3_0, minimax_hailuo, veo3_1_lite, wan2_7, marketing_studio_video [FACT - live MCP surface 2026-07-03].

The optional parameter on soul_2 and soul_cinematic that binds a trained Soul character identity to a generation. A trained Soul is usable ONLY with those two models, and only ONE soul_id fits per generation [FACT - show_characters surface].

An instant (no training) reusable character/environment/prop created via show_reference_elements and embedded as <<<element_id>>> placeholders inside a generate_image/generate_video prompt; multiple placeholders per prompt are allowed, which is the surface-designated path for two-persona shots. Elements are NOT usable with the Soul models [FACT - tool descriptions].

Setting get_cost:true on a generate_* call returns the credit cost WITHOUT submitting the job — the sanctioned zero-spend price check, and the only mechanism for per-model costs since no read surface exposes them [FACT - generate_* schemas; costs themselves UNKNOWN until probed].

As a TOOL, generate_audio is speech-only and must decline general music/SFX requests. As a boolean PARAMETER on several video models it toggles native audio in the clip (default true on seedance_2_0/mini/seedance1_5; default false on cinematic_studio_3_0 and veo3_1_lite, the latter at extra cost). Conflating the two meanings mis-plans a soundtrack [FACT - live schemas 2026-07-03].

cinematic_studio_video_v2's native speed-ramp transition parameter (auto/custom/linear/slowmo/speedup/impact) — one of the few in-schema camera-feel controls, since no model exposes a camera-move enum [FACT - live schema].

The look-steering enum on the cinema-studio and Seedance families: cinematic_studio_3_0 and seedance_2_0 offer auto/action/horror/comedy/noir/drama/epic; cinematic_studio_video_v2 offers auto/action/horror/comedy/western/suspense/intimate/spectacle [FACT - live schemas].

One of 49 choreographed image-to-video templates returned by presets_show (id + name + description + preview mp4), e.g. 2000'S PAPARAZZI, RED CARPET, Earth zoom in. The higgsfield_preset model REQUIRES a preset_id and takes exactly one image; cinematic_studio_video_v2 also exposes a preset_id param, but cross-route validity of the 49 ids is UNKNOWN [FACT + UNKNOWN - presets_show, schemas].

The Kling 3.0 Motion Control tool: animates a character image with the motion AND camera movement of a reference video (recast, puppeteer, motion transfer) via image_id + motion_video_id, resolution 720p/1080p, scene_control image|video, with NO prompt — the strongest camera-trick replication lever on the surface [FACT - schema].

nodes.definition: Read each model's conditioning capability off its declared medias[].roles, never off its name or description. The roles observed across the catalog are: image (generic reference), start_image (first frame), end_image (last frame), image_references (multi-image identity/style refs), video_references, audio_references, and input_video (utilities) [FACT - live MCP surface 2026-07-03]. A shot plan that assigns a conditioning input to a model lacking that role is unexecutable, so the role table is read before any storyboard commits to a model.

nodes.definition: Defeat the plastic AI look at the wording level. Cause: models are trained on heavily retouched, beauty-filtered photos, so over-smooth skin is the learned default; real skin has pores, fine lines and color shifts that scatter light unevenly [FACT - concordant practitioner guides]. Positive fixes: 'natural skin texture with visible pores, subtle fine lines, realistic uneven skin tone, slight natural shine'; demand imperfections (freckles, color variation); specify real optics ('85mm lens', 'f/1.8', 'natural window lighting'); prefer directional side light over flat ring light so micro-shadows read as texture; subtle film grain restores realism [FACT - same guides]. Sora adds: concrete light anchors beat adjectives, and naming 3-5 palette colors stabilizes grade [FACT - fetched Cookbook]. Wording that CAUSES the look: 'flawless skin', 'perfect', 'smooth skin', 'beauty', 'airbrushed', ring-light flatness [FACT]; stacked hype tokens ('ultra-realistic, 8K, masterpiece, hyperdetailed') add little on modern natural-language models and can drag toward CG aesthetics — model-class dependent [ESTIMATE, medium-high confidence]. Negative-prompt practice: FLUX.2 does NOT support negative prompts ('describe what you want') [FACT - excerpt]; Kling has a dedicated 2,500-char negative field [FACT]; Midjourney uses --no with single-concept items only [FACT]; Veo wants exclusions as content nouns, not 'don't show' instructions [FACT]. Studio default negative block for models with a field (ESTIMATE): 'plastic skin, waxy, airbrushed, over-smoothed, doll-like, 3d render, cgi, beauty filter, extra fingers, warped hands, morphing, flicker, watermark, subtitles, text overlay, oversaturated' — pruned per model. UNKNOWN: whether the Higgsfield MCP generate_image/generate_video schemas expose seed or negative-prompt fields per model — read the live schemas, do not assume.

dominance_rules.rationale: beauty/perfection vocabulary and token stacks push toward the retouched or CG training modes — the exact 'AI look' the pipeline must avoid
dominance_rules.trigger: a photoreal prompt is being worded
dominance_rules.action: replace hype tokens with lens/aperture/light-direction/film-stock specifics and texture-imperfection wording

dominance_rules.rule: Motion-only wording dominates scene re-description once a frame conditions the call
dominance_rules.rationale: official i2v guidance: re-describing image content reduces motion or causes unexpected results
dominance_rules.trigger: an i2v or interpolation prompt is being written
dominance_rules.action: strip visual description to ~10% atmosphere and spend the budget on one camera move plus one beat-counted action

dominance_rules.rule: Explicit audio flags dominate model defaults across a mixed-model reel
dominance_rules.rationale: defaults contradict each other (seedance true, cinematic_studio_3_0 and veo3_1_lite false with lite costing extra), producing inconsistent sound silently
dominance_rules.trigger: a reel mixes models with different audio defaults
dominance_rules.action: set generate_audio/sound explicitly on every clip and budget surcharges

dominance_rules.rule: A named UNKNOWN dominates a plausible guess everywhere in the pipeline
dominance_rules.rationale: the honesty contract: costs, fidelity gaps, preset interop, seed fields and spatial audio are unmeasured — inventing them corrupts every downstream decision
dominance_rules.trigger: a plan needs a value the enumeration did not carry
dominance_rules.action: carry the UNKNOWN, design the cheap run-phase test, and branch the plan on its outcomes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read the target model's medias[].roles before storyboarding any conditioned shot
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering mid-run that the model takes no end_image (veo3_1) or no frames at all (wan2_6, gemini_omni) and re-planning the whole transition

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the aspect ratio before shortlisting models
anti_rework_rules.prevents: generating a soul_2 hero frame that can never be 21:9 and re-rendering the deliverable on soul_cinematic

anti_rework_rules.rule: Create Elements for both personas before authoring any duo-shot prompts
anti_rework_rules.prevents: writing duo prompts against Soul models that structurally cannot hold two identities, then rewriting them for the Element placeholder syntax

anti_rework_rules.rule: Band-check every clip slot's duration against the model before locking the reel timeline
anti_rework_rules.prevents: silent clamping (seedance1_5 min 4, minimax min 6, marketing 12) desynchronizing the stitch and forcing regeneration

anti_rework_rules.rule: Probe get_cost on each new model/resolution/duration cell before the first batch
anti_rework_rules.prevents: burning the 1,010-credit budget on unpriced 4k/15s cells and abandoning the reel mid-chain

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set every clip's audio flag explicitly at plan time
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a silent veo3_1_lite/cinematic_studio_3_0 clip discovered at edit time, requiring regeneration with the flag and surcharge

anti_rework_rules.rule: Review each end frame before it seeds the next clip in a chain
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an identity-drifted or flickering frame propagating through clips 4-8 and forcing a multi-clip regeneration

anti_rework_rules.rule: Lock the character block and reuse it verbatim across shots before scaling generation
anti_rework_rules.prevents: paraphrase-driven identity drift that invalidates a batch of otherwise-good frames

anti_rework_rules.rule: Ingest external assets through media_upload/media_import_url + media_confirm before writing call plans
anti_rework_rules.prevents: URL-valued media fields failing at run time and stalling every dependent clip

iteration_protocol.trigger: the run phase begins or a call contradicts the recorded surface
iteration_protocol.action: re-run models_explore on all three types and diff against the snapshot; update every membership list (both-frames, start-only, element-compatible) that changed
run get_cost:true across the decision tree's model/resolution/duration cells and replace the cost UNKNOWN with a probed table; re-rank branches by quality-per-credit

iteration_protocol.trigger: Souls and Elements both exist for one persona
iteration_protocol.action: run the fidelity A/B (same prompt, soul_id vs <<<element_id>>>) and record the measured gap, updating the solo/duo routing if Elements hold identity adequately

iteration_protocol.trigger: a preset-shaped shot enters the plan
iteration_protocol.action: test one presets_show id on the cinematic_studio_video_v2 preset_id param cheaply to resolve the cross-route UNKNOWN before building beats on it

iteration_protocol.trigger: an Element generation must target the nano-banana family
iteration_protocol.action: run one cheap element generation and inspect which model id the job records, resolving the naming collision; until then route Elements via unambiguous ids

iteration_protocol.trigger: the live generate_image/generate_video schemas are re-read at run time
iteration_protocol.action: record whether seed and negative-prompt fields exist per model and update the iteration and negative-block protocols accordingly
grade whether any model's audio is spatially convincing, resolving the spatial-audio UNKNOWN, and update the scoring routes

iteration_protocol.trigger: a stitched chain shows flicker, drift or a rejected job_id media value
iteration_protocol.action: diagnose the failing link (frame mismatch, model interpolation, envelope rule), repair per the chain checks, and update the chain protocol with the finding

priority_rationale: The catalog snapshot, call envelope and media-role taxonomy come first because every other claim in the KB is a quotation from or a partition of that enumerated surface; the image/video tierings and their qualifiers (Soul family, ratios, both-frames vs start-only, duration bands, the speech-only audio rule) follow as the factual substrate; the identity, preset and motion-control surfaces then define the reusable assets and camera routes; the prompting nodes convert surface facts into wording discipline; and the shot-type decision tree plus the cost-probe iteration loop come last because they compose every upstream constraint into executable, priced, improvable calls.
